messages.subject: geomorph 3.1.2 available
parts:
Colleagues,

 

Version 3.1.2 of geomorph is now available on CRAN as source-file, and over the next few days the CRAN folks will generate the binaries also.

 

This version is a patch, fixing some issues created when the RGL library recently made changes to their package - regarding how colors/materials of 3D meshes were handled -  which caused some cascading issues for some using geomorph for 3D digitizing from surface scans. Additionally, a few other minor issues were also cleaned up, and are documented in the NEWS file. There are also two more vignettes to guide users through the geomorph experience.

 

Dean
